005015d5-313d-474c-8917-c4368a59ddcd.name: Aspirin
005015d5-313d-474c-8917-c4368a59ddcd.description: Shifokor buyurmagan bo‘lsa, uni (kardioaspirinni) og‘riq qoldiruvchi sifatida qabul qilish mumkin emas.

02c1f7c4-6c8b-428b-a335-a14f4392a4d7.name: Dolchin
02c1f7c4-6c8b-428b-a335-a14f4392a4d7.description: Ziravor sifatida xavfsiz. Qondagi qand miqdorini me’yorda saqlashga yordam beradi.

11901ed2-a265-4223-a5b8-e5cbfb8f773e.name: Qo‘ziqorin
11901ed2-a265-4223-a5b8-e5cbfb8f773e.description: Faqat yetishtirilgan (do‘konda sotiladigan) qo‘ziqorinlarni va to‘liq pishirilgan holda iste’mol qiling. O‘rmon qo‘ziqorinlari xavfli.

11e23f3d-d80c-4605-a45a-22a7947b2a6b.name: Yalpiz
11e23f3d-d80c-4605-a45a-22a7947b2a6b.description: Yalpiz choyi ko‘ngil aynishiga yordam beradi. Yalpiz moyini esa ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlatish kerak.

13f101f3-04c4-4778-9891-0b68a21fef96.name: Uzum
13f101f3-04c4-4778-9891-0b68a21fef96.description: Yaxshilab yuvish kerak. Tarkibida resveratrol bor, ammo shakar miqdori yuqori, shuning uchun me’yorida iste’mol qilish lozim.

13f91873-c1b0-43b8-bc6b-9166281d9d9a.name: Elektron sigaret (Vape)
13f91873-c1b0-43b8-bc6b-9166281d9d9a.description: Nikotin homilaning miyasiga zarar yetkazadi. Tarkibi to‘liq o‘rganilmagan.

14172da9-4efa-42a0-8893-7757c2900a61.name: Mineral suv
14172da9-4efa-42a0-8893-7757c2900a61.description: Xavfsiz, jig‘ildon qaynashini yengillashtirishga yordam berishi mumkin.

089bec31-a38b-4891-852a-00ce9e78068b.name: Progesteron (Dufaston)
089bec31-a38b-4891-852a-00ce9e78068b.description: Homila tushish xavfi bo‘lganda shifokor tomonidan buyuriladi. O‘zboshimchalik bilan qabul qilish mumkin emas.

093501ce-f6a1-4966-ab3f-5fade42e305a.name: Kraker
093501ce-f6a1-4966-ab3f-5fade42e305a.description: Sho‘r krakerlar toksikoz paytida yordam beradi.

0a4654e9-7c41-473b-a757-76ec9bb1fb2b.name: Ketchup
0a4654e9-7c41-473b-a757-76ec9bb1fb2b.description: Xavfsiz, ammo tarkibidagi shakar va tuz sababli oz miqdorda iste’mol qiling.

0b5776be-e0b1-4051-a79c-004825eeecfc.name: Gazlangan shirin ichimliklar
0b5776be-e0b1-4051-a79c-004825eeecfc.description: Zararli emas, ammo shakar va gaz qorin dam bo‘lishi hamda vazn ortishiga olib keladi.

0d5a2005-cbee-4482-bdab-a34909be9607.name: Do‘shob (Bekmez)
0d5a2005-cbee-4482-bdab-a34909be9607.description: Tut yoki uzum do‘shobi temir manbai bo‘lib, kamqonlikda foydali.

175f0053-64b2-4e76-b5a5-673b01d8ac1e.name: Xangal (yaproq)
175f0053-64b2-4e76-b5a5-673b01d8ac1e.description: Bu xamirli taom bo‘lib, xavfsiz hisoblanadi. Qiymasi to‘liq pishgan bo‘lishi kerak.

19ca769a-11f7-46db-8963-6172b215a50a.name: Kunjut
19ca769a-11f7-46db-8963-6172b215a50a.description: Non ustida yoki tahini ko‘rinishida oz miqdorda iste’mol qilish mumkin. Ko‘p miqdori bachadonga ta’sir qilishi mumkin.

19d422d5-be20-4643-8e69-e66fb97f5167.name: Kiprik uzaytirish
19d422d5-be20-4643-8e69-e66fb97f5167.description: Agar yelim hidiga reaksiya bo‘lmasa, xavfsiz hisoblanadi.

19fe3138-0e8f-487a-88e9-ac466b8e7455.name: Deraza artish
19fe3138-0e8f-487a-88e9-ac466b8e7455.description: Balandlikdan yiqilish xavfi bor. Ehtiyot bo‘ling.

1c5a11d7-6647-4d9c-b566-6ed1d207f677.name: Soch bo‘yog‘i
1c5a11d7-6647-4d9c-b566-6ed1d207f677.description: 1-trimestrdan keyin, yaxshi shamollatiladigan xonada va ammiaksiz bo‘yoqlardan foydalanish mumkin.

1ec8f09a-93f7-4090-a7b3-291ec4bebda6.name: Kabob (go‘sht)
1ec8f09a-93f7-4090-a7b3-291ec4bebda6.description: To‘liq pishgan bo‘lishi ("qonli" qolmasligi) kerak. Kuygan qismlarini iste’mol qilish tavsiya etilmaydi.

14729a17-9a8e-479b-8332-5813c2a6ed6c.name: Quyoshdan himoya kremi (SPF)
14729a17-9a8e-479b-8332-5813c2a6ed6c.description: Fizik filtrlar (rux oksidi, titan dioksidi) ma’qulroq. Pigment dog‘laridan himoya qiladi.

14797472-1740-468f-a25a-a0879705d4d1.name: Midiya (dengiz mollyuskalari)
14797472-1740-468f-a25a-a0879705d4d1.description: Zaharlanish xavfi yuqori. Xom holda iste’mol qilish qat’iyan taqiqlanadi.

14a47061-074d-4b9c-ba69-91bae5938a58.name: Shakarbura / Paxlava
14a47061-074d-4b9c-ba69-91bae5938a58.description: Tarkibi xavfsiz, ammo tarkibidagi ko‘p miqdordagi shakar vazn ortishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

155a10db-1b9e-42ee-9e71-19faf80ca313.name: Gilos / Olcha
155a10db-1b9e-42ee-9e71-19faf80ca313.description: Xavfsiz, melatonin (uyqu) uchun foydali bo‘lishi mumkin.

15712c68-a377-4501-ab80-a6a7e1d0080f.name: Atseton
15712c68-a377-4501-ab80-a6a7e1d0080f.description: Tirnoq bo‘yog‘ini ketkazish uchun ishlatish mumkin, ammo xonani shamollating.

15ac1978-1b26-401f-9d90-9abd8877dac3.name: Marmarak (Sage)
15ac1978-1b26-401f-9d90-9abd8877dac3.description: Bachadon qisqarishiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkinligi uchun tavsiya etilmaydi.

15b4c8fc-e833-437f-bcb0-da0e8f2dd040.name: Qizil mevasi
15b4c8fc-e833-437f-bcb0-da0e8f2dd040.description: C vitamini manbai bo‘lib, qon bosimini me’yorda ushlab turishga yordam beradi.

15feef97-b285-4534-90a8-6dd8cc6994e2.name: Ich suruvchi vositalar
15feef97-b285-4534-90a8-6dd8cc6994e2.description: Tabiiy vositalar (turshak, olxo‘ri) yaxshiroq. Dori vositalarini faqat shifokor bilan maslahatlashib qabul qiling.

16141dbb-2ea0-46a1-92bb-a4a9cbc211bd.name: Motal pishlog‘i
16141dbb-2ea0-46a1-92bb-a4a9cbc211bd.description: Xom sutdan tayyorlangan bo‘lishi va tarkibida tuz juda ko‘p bo‘lishi mumkin. Ehtiyot bo‘ling.

16a15229-2aac-4e4f-ae08-5d1a792405ad.name: Qovoq
16a15229-2aac-4e4f-ae08-5d1a792405ad.description: Juda foydali, kletchatka va vitaminlarga boy.

170aa39f-276b-4e8a-a118-072d9205cb2a.name: Sho‘r
170aa39f-276b-4e8a-a118-072d9205cb2a.description: Xavfsiz, agar juda sho‘r bo‘lsa, suvda ivitib qo‘ying.

2ba4fe11-76b1-4110-8626-0826230bb91c.name: Kungaboqar urug‘i
2ba4fe11-76b1-4110-8626-0826230bb91c.description: Foliy kislotasi va E vitamini manbai.

2c380853-1d73-4853-a94f-5df5664edb6d.name: D vitamini
2c380853-1d73-4853-a94f-5df5664edb6d.description: Shifokor belgilagan dozada qabul qilish kerak.

2f141477-bea5-4d25-867b-b67d3e0d3866.name: Chips
2f141477-bea5-4d25-867b-b67d3e0d3866.description: Zararli yog‘lar va tuzni o‘z ichiga oladi. Kamdan-kam hollarda iste’mol qilish mumkin.

3053a573-4429-4e68-86c4-0e7aa8a0013d.name: Zarchava (kurkuma)
3053a573-4429-4e68-86c4-0e7aa8a0013d.description: Immunitet uchun foydali, taomlarda ishlatish mumkin.

2841191c-cf23-4b01-bf5f-86a558ecb36a.name: Mikrobleyding
2841191c-cf23-4b01-bf5f-86a558ecb36a.description: Infeksiya xavfi va og‘riq sababli tavsiya etilmaydi.

28775f4a-1fa8-4cb7-8dac-0132827acef9.name: Yod
28775f4a-1fa8-4cb7-8dac-0132827acef9.description: Qalqonsimon bez faoliyati va homila miyasining rivojlanishi uchun muhim.

2b2dad7b-3bcb-456f-8c6d-6200781cc993.name: Tishlarni davolash
2b2dad7b-3bcb-456f-8c6d-6200781cc993.description: Mahalliy anesteziya (lidokain) homiladorlar uchun xavfsiz. Infeksiyani davolash muhim.

2b3dc439-9ff4-4b53-993b-7cea853548d1.name: Qosh laminatsiyasi
2b3dc439-9ff4-4b53-993b-7cea853548d1.description: Kimyoviy moddalar teriga tegishi mumkin. Allergiya testini o‘tkazing.

30b06132-c93e-44ce-9d7a-1661b85b1e60.name: Pirsing
30b06132-c93e-44ce-9d7a-1661b85b1e60.description: Infeksiya xavfi bor. Qorin sohasidagi pirsingni olib tashlash kerak.

31868710-84f8-405d-97d0-cd526f998a88.name: Botoks / Filler
31868710-84f8-405d-97d0-cd526f998a88.description: Axloqiy sabablarga ko‘ra homiladorlarda sinovdan o‘tkazilmagan, kosmetologlar tavakkal qilmaydi.

32160fb8-7760-4e41-8ffe-b27506c0e08f.name: Tirnoq bo‘yog‘i (lak)
32160fb8-7760-4e41-8ffe-b27506c0e08f.description: Toluol va formaldegid saqlamaydigan ("3-free" yoki "5-free") laklarni tanlang. Xonani shamollating.

329e973f-89c7-4150-936a-d3b2b4a30283.name: Avtomobil haydash
329e973f-89c7-4150-936a-d3b2b4a30283.description: Xavfsizlik kamarini qorin ostidan taqish sharti bilan xavfsizdir.

33035124-c776-4553-8ff5-b7c8bb0b8d3c.name: Valeriana
33035124-c776-4553-8ff5-b7c8bb0b8d3c.description: Tinchlantiruvchi vosita sifatida. Shifokor bilan maslahatlashing.

346d0133-99be-475b-b417-67945f3cc71f.name: Paratsetamol
346d0133-99be-475b-b417-67945f3cc71f.description: Og‘riq va isitma uchun birinchi tanlovdir.

214a8105-e97d-46f4-bfa3-4285b64abb38.name: Kompyuterda ishlash
214a8105-e97d-46f4-bfa3-4285b64abb38.description: Har soatda o‘rningizdan turib, yurib turing (qon aylanishi uchun).

2480a0e0-51da-49e1-9ad2-f6accaaf2639.name: Yashil choy
2480a0e0-51da-49e1-9ad2-f6accaaf2639.description: Tarkibida kofein bor va foliy kislotasining so‘rilishiga xalaqit berishi mumkin. Kuniga 1 piyola.

256b8c29-d4c6-497b-96ad-14febc117057.name: Efir moylari
256b8c29-d4c6-497b-96ad-14febc117057.description: Dastlabki 3 oyda ulardan saqlaning. Lavanda va choy daraxti moyini keyinchalik oz miqdorda ishlatish mumkin.

25c7527b-591c-4620-959d-e45daeaea7e8.name: Aloe vera (gel)
25c7527b-591c-4620-959d-e45daeaea7e8.description: Teriga surtish xavfsiz. Ichga qabul qilish (sharbatini ichish) ich suruvchi ta’siri tufayli mumkin emas.

26a4dcad-717d-4451-8a11-003e8508571f.name: Lavashak
26a4dcad-717d-4451-8a11-003e8508571f.description: Xavfsiz, nordon-shirin ta’mi toksikoz paytida yordam berishi mumkin.

2816eb9b-6c75-4242-869c-91b793782e84.name: Marafon yugurish
2816eb9b-6c75-4242-869c-91b793782e84.description: Homiladorlik davrida marafon yugurish yuqori jismoniy zo‘riqish va ehtimoliy xavflar tufayli odatda tavsiya etilmaydi. Shaxsiy tavsiya olish uchun shifokoringiz bilan maslahatlashing.

3473200c-9a7d-48b0-928c-8e9da88800b1.name: Spirtsiz pivo
3473200c-9a7d-48b0-928c-8e9da88800b1.description: Tarkibida oz miqdorda (0.5%) alkogol bo‘lishi mumkin. Ehtiyot bo‘ling.

3982c1ae-13f7-4142-8726-4f0481aa7c58.name: Quyoshda bo‘lish
3982c1ae-13f7-4142-8726-4f0481aa7c58.description: Me’yorida quyoshda bo‘lish odatda xavfsiz va D vitamini ishlab chiqarilishiga yordam beradi. Biroq quyoshda uzoq vaqt qolish suvsizlanish, issiq urishi va quyoshda kuyishga olib kelishi mumkin, bu esa noqulaylik tug‘dirishi va salomatlikka zarar yetkazishi mumkin. Bevosita quyosh nurlari ostida bo‘lishni, ayniqsa eng issiq paytda (ertalab soat 10 dan kechki 4 gacha) cheklash, himoya kiyimlarini kiyish, quyoshdan himoyalovchi kremdan foydalanish va ko‘proq suyuqlik ichish tavsiya etiladi.

3cea4532-7848-493f-a0d6-e06099618ef1.name: Suzish
3cea4532-7848-493f-a0d6-e06099618ef1.description: Eng yaxshi sport turlaridan biridir. Suvi toza hovuzda yoki dengizda suzishni afzal ko‘ring.

3d080cee-a173-4d17-8b0b-c3313c09349e.name: Retinol (A vitamini)
3d080cee-a173-4d17-8b0b-c3313c09349e.description: Krem va tabletkalar shaklida qo‘llash taqiqlanadi. Homilaga teratogen ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.

410cde1d-5aea-4d7b-bb9b-fe8f45a749d3.name: Analgin
410cde1d-5aea-4d7b-bb9b-fe8f45a749d3.description: Qon hosil bo‘lishiga salbiy ta’sir qilishi mumkin. Parasetamolni tanlang.

43a45a81-8784-41a1-b75a-fb08a503e946.name: Arslonquyruq (Motherwort)
43a45a81-8784-41a1-b75a-fb08a503e946.description: Tinchlantiruvchi vosita sifatida qo‘llanadi, ammo shifokor bilan maslahatlashing.

4409ab79-8040-400f-874e-3014663cbb59.name: Kashnich
4409ab79-8040-400f-874e-3014663cbb59.description: Oziq-ovqat miqdorida (ko‘kat sifatida) iste’mol qilish xavfsiz.

445ab6ae-6f5b-45dd-948c-e1fb40b68b41.name: Akril / Gel tirnoqlar
445ab6ae-6f5b-45dd-948c-e1fb40b68b41.description: Chang va kimyoviy hidlardan himoyalanish uchun niqob taqing. UV-lampa zararsiz.

3d4abaa1-3e7a-4a70-ba17-3a98380b262e.name: Solariy
3d4abaa1-3e7a-4a70-ba17-3a98380b262e.description: Haddan tashqari qizib ketish va UV nurlari zararli. Avtozagar (Self-tan) kremlari xavfsizroq.

3e56c556-b839-4f2c-b232-3ab20776411e.name: Jamoat hammomi
3e56c556-b839-4f2c-b232-3ab20776411e.description: Infeksiya xavfi va yuqori harorat sababli tavsiya etilmaydi.

3ee1c3b7-b903-492c-8602-996750c186b8.name: Qutab (ko‘katli/go‘shtli)
3ee1c3b7-b903-492c-8602-996750c186b8.description: Ko‘katlar yaxshilab yuvilishi, go‘sht esa to‘liq pishirilishi kerak.

3f8bf8fd-9d0c-44e6-bcfe-aba1fd9bdaba.name: Tuzlama (marinad)
3f8bf8fd-9d0c-44e6-bcfe-aba1fd9bdaba.description: Xavfsiz, ishtahani ochadi. Tuz miqdori tufayli shish paydo qilishi mumkin.

4bc02c92-bff2-4d26-b42d-9123d3f84aed.name: Ajdar mevasi
4bc02c92-bff2-4d26-b42d-9123d3f84aed.description: Ajdar mevasini homiladorlik davrida iste'mol qilish odatda xavfsiz. U homilador ayollar uchun foydali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan vitaminlar, minerallar va tolaning yaxshi manbaidir.

4bf58079-aa14-4344-8177-0c7e093fb7fd.name: Kvas
4bf58079-aa14-4344-8177-0c7e093fb7fd.description: Tarkibida oz miqdorda spirt bo'lishi mumkin (achish mahsuloti). Ehtiyot bo'ling.

4d71f90e-d40d-49a3-a894-6e5ac5b95bc2.name: Xina (Henna)
4d71f90e-d40d-49a3-a894-6e5ac5b95bc2.description: Tabiiy xina xavfsiz. Kimyoviy qo'shimchalar qo'shilgan "qora xina"dan saqlaning.

4e56afe8-e5aa-4f52-9505-f2461311be94.name: Qovun
4e56afe8-e5aa-4f52-9505-f2461311be94.description: Xavfsiz, ammo yaxshilab yuvish kerak (po'stlog'idagi bakteriyalar tufayli).

4e861e2a-5668-4dd0-b2c7-733c3191cebf.name: Dimedrol
4e861e2a-5668-4dd0-b2c7-733c3191cebf.description: Bachadon qisqarishlariga sabab bo'lishi mumkin, tavsiya etilmaydi.

4ed749d3-e969-49f1-95f3-cb9354d1022c.name: Burun spreylari
4ed749d3-e969-49f1-95f3-cb9354d1022c.description: Tuzli suv (Akvamaris) mutlaqo xavfsiz. Qon tomirlarni toraytiruvchi vositalarni (Ksilometazolin) 3-5 kundan ortiq ishlatmaslik kerak.

4f691cd1-d199-495e-ad77-36cafbbe20a5.name: Kombucha
4f691cd1-d199-495e-ad77-36cafbbe20a5.description: Tarkibida oz miqdorda alkogol va tirik bakteriyalar bo‘lishi mumkin.

50fbfc91-971a-4630-9616-e61d1e952266.name: Konsert
50fbfc91-971a-4630-9616-e61d1e952266.description: Juda baland ovoz chaqaloqni bezovta qilishi mumkin.

519f485f-bbfa-43a2-ab16-3cf1e139361b.name: Margarin
519f485f-bbfa-43a2-ab16-3cf1e139361b.description: Tarkibida transyog‘lar bor, sariyog‘ni afzal ko‘ring.

5244c1bd-462f-4e11-80c4-c7698bf4eb81.name: Xom sut
5244c1bd-462f-4e11-80c4-c7698bf4eb81.description: Qaynatilmagan qishloq suti bakteriyalar manbai hisoblanadi. Uni albatta qaynatish yoki pasterizatsiya qilinganini sotib olish kerak.

529cbeb0-75e5-405b-980d-b468a119e536.name: Ko‘katli omlet
529cbeb0-75e5-405b-980d-b468a119e536.description: Ko‘katlar va tuxum to‘liq pishirilgan bo‘lsa, xavfsizdir.

56b28fa6-2463-4319-a977-abdfc415b72f.name: Xantal (gorchitsa)
56b28fa6-2463-4319-a977-abdfc415b72f.description: Sous sifatida oz miqdorda iste’mol qilish xavfsiz.

580c9e78-3ae2-44f8-a423-d1a876ee79a7.name: Sakrash (Jumping)
580c9e78-3ae2-44f8-a423-d1a876ee79a7.description: Bo‘g‘imlar bo‘shashgani sababli jarohatlanish xavfi bor. Bachadonga bosim tushiradi.

5340f447-5183-44c1-a1e3-6279a989c56c.name: Muzqaymoq
5340f447-5183-44c1-a1e3-6279a989c56c.description: Pasterizatsiya qilingan sutdan tayyorlangan bo‘lsa, xavfsiz. Ko‘chada sotiladigan "yumshoq" muzqaymoqlarda bakteriyalar bo‘lishi xavfi mavjud.

53bfc9ec-dd79-4134-9377-7aa0dbecaa42.name: Ta’mirlash (bo‘yoq hidi)
53bfc9ec-dd79-4134-9377-7aa0dbecaa42.description: Erituvchilar va bo‘yoq bug‘lari zararli. Xonada qolmang.

55091d3f-e65c-41cc-91a3-9aee86cea4b1.name: Mayonez
55091d3f-e65c-41cc-91a3-9aee86cea4b1.description: Uyda xom tuxumdan tayyorlangan mayonezni iste’mol qilish mumkin emas. Do‘kon mayonezi (pasterizatsiya qilingan tuxumdan tayyorlangan) xavfsiz.

560a1bdf-8d00-4164-87ab-508083cf5275.name: Xom tuxum
560a1bdf-8d00-4164-87ab-508083cf5275.description: Salmonella xavfi mavjud. "Gogol-mogol", xom xamir yoki chala pishgan tuxum iste’mol qilish mumkin emas. Tuxum to‘liq pishirilishi kerak.

56778e31-ace8-48db-ae70-70dece506207.name: Temir (Iron)
56778e31-ace8-48db-ae70-70dece506207.description: Kamqonlik (anemiya) bo‘lsa, shifokor tavsiyasiga ko‘ra qabul qilinadi. Ich qotishiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.

56815cf3-8027-47e0-98e6-8d6cdd30d7f7.name: Quritilgan mevalar
56815cf3-8027-47e0-98e6-8d6cdd30d7f7.description: Mayiz, turshak va quritilgan o‘rik xavfsiz (yaxshilab yuvish kerak).

5b79dbab-363f-4c10-88a5-bb4e7d1189f0.name: Krevetka
5b79dbab-363f-4c10-88a5-bb4e7d1189f0.description: To‘liq pishirilgan holda xavfsiz. Xom yoki chala pishirilganini iste’mol qilmang.

5c1830c9-88e2-4841-8a68-b24e260dc873.name: Pitsa
5c1830c9-88e2-4841-8a68-b24e260dc873.description: Tarkibidagi pishloq (pasterizatsiya qilingan) va kolbasa (pishirilgan) ekanini tekshirish kerak.

5cb8457a-e57a-462e-ab62-e24b3526d8ba.name: Bouling
5cb8457a-e57a-462e-ab62-e24b3526d8ba.description: Shar juda og‘ir bo‘lmasligi kerak. Ehtiyot bo‘ling (pol sirpanchiq bo‘lishi mumkin).

5d083314-2569-43ea-ae23-fc114fbfce9c.name: Tetratsiklin
5d083314-2569-43ea-ae23-fc114fbfce9c.description: Homilaning suyaklari va tishlari rivojlanishini buzadi.

5f1e0613-8338-4aa2-b8f4-9ceaf2ed0b06.name: Gidroxinon
5f1e0613-8338-4aa2-b8f4-9ceaf2ed0b06.description: Dog‘larni oqartiruvchi modda bo‘lib, homiladorlikda qo‘llash tavsiya etilmaydi.

5f509ef7-f1c9-4d9c-99c2-3a0e4a01a0f0.name: Baland poshnali oyoq kiyim
5f509ef7-f1c9-4d9c-99c2-3a0e4a01a0f0.description: Og‘irlik markazi o‘zgargani sababli bel og‘rig‘i va yiqilish xavfini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

5f82fb09-4272-450a-a938-9061a1796d85.name: Metoklopramid (Cerucal)
5f82fb09-4272-450a-a938-9061a1796d85.description: Kuchli qusishda faqat shifokor tavsiyasi bilan qo‘llanadi.

5f83ff5e-3c19-423e-98db-8ded8ee940d3.name: Holva
5f83ff5e-3c19-423e-98db-8ded8ee940d3.description: Xavfsiz, ammo tarkibida shakar juda ko‘p va kaloriyasi juda yuqori.

601714d8-610c-438d-a0d7-5877c0bf636a.name: Keratin (soch uchun)
601714d8-610c-438d-a0d7-5877c0bf636a.description: Ko‘plab keratin vositalari tarkibida zararli formaldegid mavjud.

633e6263-8f53-4f9e-bd0f-e7a29527e3a4.name: Probiotiklar
633e6263-8f53-4f9e-bd0f-e7a29527e3a4.description: Ovqat hazm qilish tizimi uchun xavfsiz.

67bf765d-e81e-422c-98d9-7f20a6cd4779.name: Salitsil kislotasi
67bf765d-e81e-422c-98d9-7f20a6cd4779.description: Yuqori foizli pilinglardan foydalanish mumkin emas. Yuvish vositalarida (2%-gacha) xavfsiz.

602aceb1-5ab8-47bc-98de-4efa57d115a8.name: Benzoil peroksid
602aceb1-5ab8-47bc-98de-4efa57d115a8.description: Husnbuzarlar uchun past konsentratsiyali (2.5-5%) kremlar odatda xavfsizdir.

609cd044-7abe-4055-b0cc-8bd435ceecc8.name: Samolyotda uchish
609cd044-7abe-4055-b0cc-8bd435ceecc8.description: Agar homiladorlik normal kechayotgan bo‘lsa, 36-haftagacha ruxsat etiladi. Ko‘p suv iching va tez-tez harakatlaning.

612ccff1-2754-48e7-95a5-0b34f772498a.name: Kolbasa / Sosiska
612ccff1-2754-48e7-95a5-0b34f772498a.description: Yaxshilab pishirilishi kerak. Xom dudlangan kolbasalarda (salyami) listeriya xavfi mavjud.

6214d75f-88ec-40f6-b373-2db80810bbf5.name: Qorin uchun moy (cho‘zilish izlari)
6214d75f-88ec-40f6-b373-2db80810bbf5.description: Terini namlantirish uchun bodom yoki kokos moyidan foydalanish xavfsizdir.

6d8da89e-2915-4d50-9726-13000b119af8.name: Antiperspirant
6d8da89e-2915-4d50-9726-13000b119af8.description: Xavfsiz. Alyuminiyning homilaga zarar yetkazishi isbotlanmagan.

6fadb185-4d26-4b03-b90f-2ca2294a8a59.name: Massaj
6fadb185-4d26-4b03-b90f-2ca2294a8a59.description: Faqat homiladorlar uchun maxsus massaj. Qorin sohasiga tegmaslik kerak.

7118b69a-1054-4e8c-aa5c-be81da487610.name: Funduk / yong‘oq
7118b69a-1054-4e8c-aa5c-be81da487610.description: Omega-3 va oqsil manbai. Allergiya bo‘lmasa, tavsiya etiladi.

455c2f5c-a585-4549-98c6-f4a465fe10e5.name: Moychechak choyi
455c2f5c-a585-4549-98c6-f4a465fe10e5.description: Tinchlantiruvchi ta'sirga ega, ammo ko'p miqdorda bachadonga ta'sir qilishi mumkin. Kuniga 1 piyola bilan cheklaning.

4736feb8-a7c7-47ab-83f0-c0063f1903f5.name: Qora ikra
4736feb8-a7c7-47ab-83f0-c0063f1903f5.description: Pasterizatsiya qilingan bo‘lsa, oqsil va Omega-3 manbai hisoblanadi.

48610fa7-1910-457d-9078-9733a4ac93ef.name: Burger (Fastfud)
48610fa7-1910-457d-9078-9733a4ac93ef.description: Go‘sht to‘liq pishirilgan bo‘lishi kerak. Salatning tozaligi shubhali bo‘lishi mumkin.

48e91094-2376-4f8b-9fcb-b8dff5dabdd6.name: Tabiiy sharbatlar
48e91094-2376-4f8b-9fcb-b8dff5dabdd6.description: Pasterizatsiya qilingan sharbatlar xavfsiz. Yangi siqilgan sharbatlarni darhol ichish kerak.

4afbfd15-403c-4f25-8b02-aa586d685816.name: Piti
4afbfd15-403c-4f25-8b02-aa586d685816.description: Juda yog‘li (dumba yog‘i), hazm qilishni qiyinlashtirishi mumkin.

4bb29538-26fa-451d-93c6-87de4551a116.name: Hasharotlarga qarshi vosita
4bb29538-26fa-451d-93c6-87de4551a116.description: Zaharli. Uyga ishlov berilayotganda tashqarida bo‘ling.

6870b771-135d-4435-baf9-06ee70c3447b.name: Anjir
6870b771-135d-4435-baf9-06ee70c3447b.description: Qabziyatga qarshi ajoyib vosita (ham yangi, ham quritilgan holda).

7460ea4e-59a9-4491-a80d-ca624d9ea62f.name: Rentgen
7460ea4e-59a9-4491-a80d-ca624d9ea62f.description: Faqat juda zarur bo‘lsa. Qo‘rg‘oshinli fartuk taqish kerak. Tish rentgeni xavfsiz.

697c2aaa-a74b-4086-a444-6b7288af80bb.name: Simob miqdori yuqori bo‘lgan baliq
697c2aaa-a74b-4086-a444-6b7288af80bb.description: Akula, qirol skumbriyasi va qilichbaliqni iste’mol qilish taqiqlanadi. Simob asab tizimiga zararli.

763b5893-6ccb-484f-aab4-527f5c6fece0.name: Bulyon kubiklari
763b5893-6ccb-484f-aab4-527f5c6fece0.description: Tarkibida qo‘shimchalar (MSG) va tuz miqdori yuqori. Tabiiy bulyon yaxshiroq.

6a7efdd2-06f4-496b-a4e9-bc1dd8c0a77d.name: Ibuprofen
6a7efdd2-06f4-496b-a4e9-bc1dd8c0a77d.description: Ayniqsa, 3-trimestrda qo‘llash taqiqlanadi (yurak qon tomirlariga ta’sir qiladi).

77386829-1c50-4449-b632-8771c2292299.name: Qovurma
77386829-1c50-4449-b632-8771c2292299.description: Yog‘li va sho‘r bo‘lishi mumkin. Me’yorida iste’mol qilish kerak.

6ab31194-cd7e-4874-8d53-54c5ec49e6f2.name: Zuluk (Leech)
6ab31194-cd7e-4874-8d53-54c5ec49e6f2.description: Qonni suyultiruvchi ta'sirga ega, qon ketishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

7988917f-4c54-4fc6-9b33-a6b9eff4a3b9.name: Smetana / Qaymoq
7988917f-4c54-4fc6-9b33-a6b9eff4a3b9.description: Xavfsiz, ammo yog‘liligi yuqori (vazn ortishiga e’tibor bering).

7e0caddf-8e7a-4e66-9398-53595240fb6a.name: Jigar
7e0caddf-8e7a-4e66-9398-53595240fb6a.description: Tarkibida A vitamini (retinol) juda ko‘p. Oyiga 1-2 martadan ortiq iste’mol qilish tavsiya etilmaydi.

7f3b0fe2-64b2-4525-b035-fdbd8da666f0.name: Sigaret
7f3b0fe2-64b2-4525-b035-fdbd8da666f0.description: Homila rivojlanishining ortda qolishiga va muddatidan oldin tug‘ruqqa sabab bo‘ladi.

815319d2-9b85-4808-b962-fdda0f9d7dd7.name: Finik
815319d2-9b85-4808-b962-fdda0f9d7dd7.description: Foydali. Homiladorlikning so‘nggi haftalarida tug‘ruqni yengillashtirishi mumkinligini ko‘rsatadigan tadqiqotlar mavjud.

817378f0-f52a-42c2-9dc6-d31be38e3eae.name: Yalpizli suv (choy)
817378f0-f52a-42c2-9dc6-d31be38e3eae.description: Ko‘ngil aynishi va ovqat hazm qilish uchun foydali.

81c3085d-96d9-4f6b-a7ba-21872bb64837.name: Zirk
81c3085d-96d9-4f6b-a7ba-21872bb64837.description: Palovda oz miqdorda iste’mol qilish mumkin. Yuqori dozada (berberin) bachadon qisqarishlarini rag‘batlantirishi mumkin.

81f95f01-3b64-44d0-adc2-51f7584fefc4.name: Jinsiy aloqa
81f95f01-3b64-44d0-adc2-51f7584fefc4.description: Agar shifokor taqiqlamagan bo‘lsa (yo‘ldosh oldinda joylashmagan va bachadon tonusi bo‘lmasa), xavfsizdir.

82343624-8c0a-4b01-a207-d6aa1be80ee1.name: Popkorn
82343624-8c0a-4b01-a207-d6aa1be80ee1.description: Tuz va yog‘i kam bo‘lsa, xavfsiz tamaddi hisoblanadi.

86120127-596d-4576-9c19-6c32bfbcee8b.name: Tatuirovka
86120127-596d-4576-9c19-6c32bfbcee8b.description: Infeksiya (gepatit, OIV) xavfi va bo‘yoq tarkibi sababli taqiqlanadi.

8808c210-3a50-4913-a82e-a41050ba65ec.name: Kompot
8808c210-3a50-4913-a82e-a41050ba65ec.description: Xavfsiz, ammo tarkibida shakar ko‘p bo‘lsa, iste’molini cheklang.

89e5fddd-8b38-4b19-b691-fa64f4c6a90f.name: Zig'ir urug'i
89e5fddd-8b38-4b19-b691-fa64f4c6a90f.description: Fitoestrogenlarni o'z ichiga oladi. Kuniga 1 qoshiqdan ko'p iste'mol qilish tavsiya etilmaydi.

89eeff87-48dd-44b0-b8f9-4070b09a9d0f.name: Azelaik kislota
89eeff87-48dd-44b0-b8f9-4070b09a9d0f.description: Husnbuzar va dog'lar uchun homiladorlik davrida eng xavfsiz kislota hisoblanadi.

8a010bc8-87c8-49af-9b78-0523759fca38.name: Sirka
8a010bc8-87c8-49af-9b78-0523759fca38.description: Salatlarga oz miqdorda qo'shib iste'mol qilish xavfsiz.

8a8f0fa3-c25c-45d1-b6f6-ee989d541e2a.name: Qizilmiya ildizi choyi
8a8f0fa3-c25c-45d1-b6f6-ee989d541e2a.description: Qon bosimini oshirishi va bolaning kognitiv rivojlanishiga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.

8c790830-3d81-4c6a-86ad-ab99b3b9a793.name: Tarvuz
8c790830-3d81-4c6a-86ad-ab99b3b9a793.description: Suyuqlikka bo'lgan ehtiyojni qondiradi, ammo tarkibida shakar ko'p (diabetda ehtiyot bo'ling).

8d6e0491-4c18-4788-9af6-483ed9d1f574.name: Karam
8d6e0491-4c18-4788-9af6-483ed9d1f574.description: Foydali, ammo qorin dam bo'lishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

8ed0967f-876b-45cd-9e91-587c8d5d6e0f.name: Zanjabil
8ed0967f-876b-45cd-9e91-587c8d5d6e0f.description: Toksikoz (ko‘ngil aynishi) uchun juda yaxshi. Kunlik miqdordan oshirmaslik sharti bilan.

8fe52471-8dfb-4d7b-8864-3b1d86d9a2d9.name: Soya
8fe52471-8dfb-4d7b-8864-3b1d86d9a2d9.description: Oziq-ovqat sifatida (masalan: soya sousi) xavfsiz. Yuqori dozali izoflavon qo‘shimchalari tavsiya etilmaydi.

90b9aa92-c8f3-4b4e-b97e-e6911cdbfbd6.name: Arpabodiyon (fenxel) choyi
90b9aa92-c8f3-4b4e-b97e-e6911cdbfbd6.description: Hazm qilishga yordam beradi, ammo ko‘p miqdorda bachadon tonusini oshirishi mumkin.

92962cf9-e5ec-49cb-81b4-c102843ffd96.name: Yugurish (Running)
92962cf9-e5ec-49cb-81b4-c102843ffd96.description: Agar homiladorlikdan oldin yugurgan bo‘lsangiz, sur’atni pasaytirib davom ettirishingiz mumkin. Yangidan boshlash mumkin emas.

92a311a8-2353-49f2-a478-69bbb6e11521.name: Papaverin (shamcha)
92a311a8-2353-49f2-a478-69bbb6e11521.description: Bachadon tonusi uchun qo‘llanadi. Shifokor tavsiyasi bilan.

92a61566-5cda-42e3-aa3b-f9e0870a058d.name: No-shpa (Drotaverin)
92a61566-5cda-42e3-aa3b-f9e0870a058d.description: Ozarbayjonda bachadon tonusi uchun tez-tez buyuriladi. Faqat shifokor tavsiyasi bilan.

9465bd4b-eaf1-49d5-b708-d311399b2d80.name: Ananas
9465bd4b-eaf1-49d5-b708-d311399b2d80.description: Afsona: Tug‘ruqni boshlashi uchun 7-8 dona butun ananas yeyish kerak. Me’yorida iste’mol qilish xavfsiz.

94bf5000-5697-4c9b-b884-b1e8c0efbcda.name: Doner
94bf5000-5697-4c9b-b884-b1e8c0efbcda.description: Gigiyena bilan bog‘liq xavf bo‘lishi mumkin. Faqat ishonchli joydan olingan va to‘liq pishirilgan bo‘lishi kerak.

94c2c047-2843-4200-936a-3a9fc44240f1.name: Gibiskus (Makka guli)
94c2c047-2843-4200-936a-3a9fc44240f1.description: Ayrim tadqiqotlarga ko‘ra, u gormonal ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin, shuning uchun undan saqlanish tavsiya etiladi.

9680b85e-c13d-4194-be28-5232a7f113b1.name: Raqs
9680b85e-c13d-4194-be28-5232a7f113b1.description: Kayfiyatni ko‘taradi. Keskin harakatlar qilish va sakrash mumkin emas.

99c14318-3cfc-4075-b0a9-fe0b308313db.name: Shugaring / Vaks
99c14318-3cfc-4075-b0a9-fe0b308313db.description: Tomirlar kengayishi (varikoz) bo‘lmasa, xavfsiz. Teri odatdagidan sezgirroq bo‘lishi mumkin.

9a1a747c-7173-43b6-9b93-c2a5d9023c83.name: Malina / Maymunjon
9a1a747c-7173-43b6-9b93-c2a5d9023c83.description: Yangi uzilgan holda iste’mol qilish xavfsiz. Barglaridan tayyorlangan choy bilan adashtirmang.

9afd3dbd-2a81-4f82-b4a6-f0c365cace3a.name: Pasterizatsiya qilingan tvorog
9afd3dbd-2a81-4f82-b4a6-f0c365cace3a.description: Do‘konda sotiladigan tvorog xavfsiz va kalsiy manbai hisoblanadi. Ochiq holda sotiladigan xom tvorogga issiqlik bilan ishlov berish kerak.

9ff783a8-6911-4a46-97cd-a4a18396bb13.name: Feyxoa
9ff783a8-6911-4a46-97cd-a4a18396bb13.description: Yodga boy, qalqonsimon bez uchun foydali.

a07b8699-6338-4bca-94a8-92fcb9ae10db.name: Tikuv tikish
a07b8699-6338-4bca-94a8-92fcb9ae10db.description: Xavfsiz, ammo uzoq vaqt bir xil holatda o‘tirmang.

a4a9d193-8a0c-48ee-9372-9b37e5b999aa.name: Lazer epilyatsiyasi
a4a9d193-8a0c-48ee-9372-9b37e5b999aa.description: Lazer nuri chuqur kirmaydi, ammo og‘riq bachadon tonusini oshirishi mumkin. Shifokorlar odatda kutishni tavsiya qiladilar.

a5dd803c-a1ab-47f5-acc3-d5aefdbeca54.name: Tuz
a5dd803c-a1ab-47f5-acc3-d5aefdbeca54.description: Iste’mol qilish mumkin, ammo ko‘p miqdori shish (ödem) paydo bo‘lishiga olib keladi. Cheklash kerak.

a6497678-b148-4fbc-8e3e-7625769c440c.name: Petrushka
a6497678-b148-4fbc-8e3e-7625769c440c.description: Taomlarda ziravor sifatida ishlatish xavfsiz. Ko‘p miqdordagi sharbati yoki choyi bachadon qisqarishlarini qo‘zg‘atishi mumkin.

a7b8c93a-6b20-42cb-a6bb-3c24c2d463dd.name: Yumshoq pishloqlar
a7b8c93a-6b20-42cb-a6bb-3c24c2d463dd.description: Pasterizatsiya qilinmagan (qishloq) pishloqlari, Bri, Kamamber va Gorgonzola (mog‘orli pishloqlar) listeriya xavfini tug‘diradi.

a90e3ed7-29b4-4069-9da6-756cd3c34d3b.name: Energetik ichimliklar
a90e3ed7-29b4-4069-9da6-756cd3c34d3b.description: Tarkibida kofein, taurin va kimyoviy qo‘shimchalar ko‘p bo‘lgani sababli taqiqlanadi.

a92ffa8d-a22e-42a9-b273-e99051d02431.name: Avto-qoraytiruvchi vosita (sprey)
a92ffa8d-a22e-42a9-b273-e99051d02431.description: Teri yuzasida qoladi va qonga o‘tmaydi. Ammo spreyni nafas orqali yutib yubormaslikka harakat qiling.

a935f993-7f7f-48c5-86da-aa2d5e8367c7.name: Qo‘g‘al
a935f993-7f7f-48c5-86da-aa2d5e8367c7.description: Ziravorli bo‘lgani uchun jig‘ildon qaynashiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.

799cad69-4882-49ca-82ca-3e1794c7fa44.name: Mushuk qumi
799cad69-4882-49ca-82ca-3e1794c7fa44.description: Toksoplazmoz xavfi bor. Qumni boshqa birov almashtirishi kerak.

7b5f16d8-cb51-4a76-8024-7be7141ac630.name: Loviya
7b5f16d8-cb51-4a76-8024-7be7141ac630.description: Oqsil manbai, uni yaxshilab pishirish kerak.

7bef7061-5448-4c35-b005-2997dcec735a.name: Shivit
7bef7061-5448-4c35-b005-2997dcec735a.description: Oziq-ovqat miqdorida xavfsiz. Urug‘i (damlama) ehtiyotkorlik bilan.

a9929822-3bb0-4d7c-a4c2-2a4b33e92a3e.name: Pilates
a9929822-3bb0-4d7c-a4c2-2a4b33e92a3e.description: Bel mushaklarini mustahkamlaydi. Murabbiy homiladorligingiz haqida bilishi kerak.

aacd53cb-1bb0-4268-a1d1-9f9c135ab7ce.name: Xash / Kalla-pocha
aacd53cb-1bb0-4268-a1d1-9f9c135ab7ce.description: Juda yog‘li, xolesterin miqdorini oshirishi mumkin. Sarimsoq oshqozonni bezovta qilishi mumkin.

ab3fa79f-82f8-4fc2-a110-8c6d47485087.name: Achchiq qalampir
ab3fa79f-82f8-4fc2-a110-8c6d47485087.description: Xavfsiz, ammo jig‘ildon qaynashini kuchaytirishi mumkin.

abf9d1a9-234a-433d-9ccb-84b093abd005.name: Antigistamin (allergiyaga qarshi)
abf9d1a9-234a-433d-9ccb-84b093abd005.description: Shifokor bilan maslahatlashing. Loratadin va setirizin odatda xavfsiz hisoblanadi.

ac0aee5f-a79c-4c84-b5d8-ef03a487b436.name: Issiq vanna / Sauna
ac0aee5f-a79c-4c84-b5d8-ef03a487b436.description: Tana haroratining 39°C dan yuqori ko‘tarilishi homila uchun xavfli. Iliq dush qabul qilish mumkin.

acb890db-b750-4b72-8f5e-e8344e92d7a5.name: Saj ichi
acb890db-b750-4b72-8f5e-e8344e92d7a5.description: Juda yog‘li va qovurilgan bo‘lishi mumkin. Sabzavotli qismi foydaliroq.

ad945485-a623-4a91-afca-c9d7bba8b9c8.name: Hijoma
ad945485-a623-4a91-afca-c9d7bba8b9c8.description: Qon yo‘qotish va infeksiya xavfi mavjud. Qon bosimini tushirishi mumkin.

b0855f6d-792e-4d72-a4d4-3509c5e9f5a1.name: Parvoz
b0855f6d-792e-4d72-a4d4-3509c5e9f5a1.description: Tijorat aviakompaniyalari reyslarida uchish odatda homiladorlik davrida xavfsiz hisoblanadi. Biroq, ayniqsa uzoq davom etadigan parvozlardan oldin, homiladorlik bilan bog‘liq hech qanday muammo bo‘lmasa ham, shifokoringiz bilan maslahatlashish tavsiya etiladi. Ko‘p suv iching, qon ivib qolishining oldini olish uchun harakatlanib turing va tavsiya etilsa, kompression paypoqlardan foydalaning. Bu tavsiyalar emizikli onalarga ham tegishli, biroq uzoq parvozlarda chaqaloqni oziqlantirish va uning qulayligi uchun qo‘shimcha tayyorgarlik ko‘rish foydali bo‘lishi mumkin.

b0c7bfda-4110-4f88-8a68-a6303d1447c6.name: Losos (Syomga)
b0c7bfda-4110-4f88-8a68-a6303d1447c6.description: Omega-3 manbai. Haftasiga 2 martagacha, to‘liq pishirilgan holda iste’mol qilish tavsiya etiladi.

b1a7ab3d-fa21-4a98-ae31-159ea5e65822.name: Samolyotda uchish
b1a7ab3d-fa21-4a98-ae31-159ea5e65822.description: Tijorat reyslarida uchish odatda homiladorlik davrida xavfsiz hisoblanadi. Ayniqsa uchinchi trimestrda samolyotda uchish haqida shifokoringiz bilan maslahatlashish, qon ivib qolishining oldini olish uchun ko‘p suv ichish va harakatlanib turish tavsiya etiladi. Bu tavsiyalar emizikli onalarga ham tegishli, biroq uzoq parvozlarda chaqaloqni oziqlantirish va uning qulayligi uchun qo‘shimcha tayyorgarlik ko‘rish kerak.

b4267eb3-6e6a-46f3-93ce-1dab05fea063.name: Sujuk
b4267eb3-6e6a-46f3-93ce-1dab05fea063.description: Sujukni emizish davrida me’yorida iste’mol qilish odatda xavfsiz, biroq uning tarkibida natriy va yog‘ miqdori yuqori ekanini hisobga olish muhim. Shuningdek, achchiq mahsulotlar ba’zan ona suti orqali chaqaloqqa ta’sir qilib, bezovtalik yoki ovqat hazm qilish muammolariga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin. Chaqalog‘ingizning reaksiyasini kuzating.

7d48f86d-1b7b-41b5-a5c1-7596a6ad0774.name: Tishlarni oqartirish
7d48f86d-1b7b-41b5-a5c1-7596a6ad0774.description: Tish milklari sezgir bo‘lgani uchun bu muolajani kechiktirish tavsiya etiladi.

b4392c92-b356-4f01-8438-8c0f357714ef.name: Shokolad
b4392c92-b356-4f01-8438-8c0f357714ef.description: Kofein va shakar miqdorini hisobga olgan holda, oz miqdorda iste'mol qilish mumkin.

b73d6256-1d85-4003-b933-0538a317f86f.name: Malina bargi choyi
b73d6256-1d85-4003-b933-0538a317f86f.description: Faqat 3-trimestr oxirida (36+ hafta) tug‘ruqqa tayyorgarlik ko‘rish uchun ruxsat etiladi.

b7a6fc30-872d-4080-ab2a-e4fa0f992f45.name: Jismoniy mashqlar (yengil)
b7a6fc30-872d-4080-ab2a-e4fa0f992f45.description: Piyoda yurish, suzish va homiladorlar yogasi foydalidir.

b89c53eb-32bc-412b-9682-ea88d2687297.name: Shakar / Shirinliklar
b89c53eb-32bc-412b-9682-ea88d2687297.description: Agar gestatsion diabet xavfi mavjud bo‘lsa, qat’iy nazorat qilish kerak.

c441fedf-30cd-4df7-aeb7-6c6d4c83ce37.name: Kalyan
c441fedf-30cd-4df7-aeb7-6c6d4c83ce37.description: Sigaretga qaraganda ko‘proq is gazi va toksinlarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ca2a1163-b2b3-49fd-96d1-10ea4d670bb2.name: Qora choy
ca2a1163-b2b3-49fd-96d1-10ea4d670bb2.description: Tarkibida kofein bor, kuniga 3–4 piyoladan ortiq ichish tavsiya etilmaydi. Temir preparatlari bilan bir vaqtda ichmang.

cba6bf85-f14b-4324-9d48-90cac59a4bc7.name: Alkogol
cba6bf85-f14b-4324-9d48-90cac59a4bc7.description: Mutlaqo taqiqlanadi. Homila rivojlanishiga bevosita zarar yetkazadi.

b5136762-1228-4319-a02d-71a442045140.name: Tunets balig‘i (konserva)
b5136762-1228-4319-a02d-71a442045140.description: Haftasiga 140 grammdan oshirmaslik sharti bilan iste’mol qilish mumkin (simob xavfi).

c12e6733-ed2c-48df-9554-d169b3d3df30.name: Skuter haydash
c12e6733-ed2c-48df-9554-d169b3d3df30.description: Skuter haydash yiqilish va jarohatlanish xavfini tug‘diradi, bu esa homiladorlik davrida xavfli bo‘lishi mumkin. Bu faoliyatdan voz kechganingiz ma’qul.

c1ad91ac-a9d7-4f8b-be51-bcfc572993be.name: Kipriklarni laminatsiya qilish
c1ad91ac-a9d7-4f8b-be51-bcfc572993be.description: Kimyoviy moddalar ko‘zga tegishi mumkin, allergiya testini o‘tkazish shart.

cd2424c6-21a8-4752-9ae9-f4742dae93e4.name: Kashtan
cd2424c6-21a8-4752-9ae9-f4742dae93e4.description: Pishirilgan holda (palovda yoki pechda) iste'mol qilish xavfsiz.

cd2c71df-2aa2-4603-8a8e-9819c6aaf1aa.name: Guruch / Grechka
cd2c71df-2aa2-4603-8a8e-9819c6aaf1aa.description: Xavfsiz uglevod manbalaridir. Grechka temir manbai hisoblanadi.

cd79ac84-2fb6-4341-8c05-e49e124e966a.name: Sariyog'
cd79ac84-2fb6-4341-8c05-e49e124e966a.description: Xavfsiz, A va D vitaminlari manbai.

cdb23929-c1a6-4bcd-8e34-e26f78dde126.name: No'xat
cdb23929-c1a6-4bcd-8e34-e26f78dde126.description: Oqsil manbai, ammo qorin dam bo'lishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

ce123d1a-41fc-4af9-8298-bf41eaa43197.name: Akvarel bo'yoq
ce123d1a-41fc-4af9-8298-bf41eaa43197.description: Zararsiz, undan hobbi sifatida foydalanishingiz mumkin.

ce1b1478-cbd0-4b55-a0c0-52e6ae630be4.name: Behi
ce1b1478-cbd0-4b55-a0c0-52e6ae630be4.description: Ko'ngil aynishida foydali, hazm qilishni yaxshilaydi.

b728c753-908a-4c9b-be3a-95f134405968.name: Bulg‘ur
b728c753-908a-4c9b-be3a-95f134405968.description: Guruchga qaraganda ko‘proq kletchatka saqlaydi va foydalidir.

c2eda676-4afc-47fd-8f07-97d50bd55942.name: Kakao
c2eda676-4afc-47fd-8f07-97d50bd55942.description: Oz miqdorda iste’mol qilish mumkin. Tarkibida kofein bor.

ce5d270b-9ea1-4416-b1ff-dde38b8ca2f7.name: Bandaj (Kamar)
ce5d270b-9ea1-4416-b1ff-dde38b8ca2f7.description: Bel og‘rig‘ini kamaytiradi, shifokor tavsiyasi bilan taqing.

cf62fa05-9fb2-434a-a4ab-259a3cf6c357.name: Yong‘oq murabbosi
cf62fa05-9fb2-434a-a4ab-259a3cf6c357.description: Yodga boy, ammo tarkibida shakar ko‘p.

d0c5b1ff-d7fa-47bd-aa7c-1c513690d586.name: Do‘lma / Palov
d0c5b1ff-d7fa-47bd-aa7c-1c513690d586.description: Milliy taomlarimiz xavfsiz. Yog‘liligiga e’tibor bering.

d0d53807-e3ef-43fa-bbbf-982ca54d561a.name: Uy tozalash (kimyoviy vositalar bilan)
d0d53807-e3ef-43fa-bbbf-982ca54d561a.description: Xlor va kuchli kimyoviy moddalar bilan ishlaganda qo‘lqop kiying va derazani oching.

d8282d11-7bba-461a-a8ca-1eaa2f8b8f8c.name: Suli bo‘tqasi (Oatmeal)
d8282d11-7bba-461a-a8ca-1eaa2f8b8f8c.description: Nonushta uchun juda mos, qabziyatni kamaytiradi.

d83727f2-789f-49dc-aa6d-e6fbff9096a4.name: Sholg‘om suvi
d83727f2-789f-49dc-aa6d-e6fbff9096a4.description: Xavfsiz, ammo sho‘r va achchiq bo‘lgani uchun oshqozon va qon bosimiga e’tibor bering.

dc6517a4-e925-4d1b-9f7e-57574d39a9db.name: Dezodorant
dc6517a4-e925-4d1b-9f7e-57574d39a9db.description: Xavfsiz. Tabiiy tarkibli mahsulotni tanlagan ma’qul.

dd8a1799-d7e7-4c57-975d-6087e06a28ce.name: O‘simliklar bilan ishlash (Bog‘dorchilik)
dd8a1799-d7e7-4c57-975d-6087e06a28ce.description: Tuproqda toksoplazmoz qo‘zg‘atuvchisi bo‘lishi mumkin. Albatta qo‘lqop kiying.

dd983a6e-a9da-4d50-bf3f-11e40f8ee87e.name: Antibiotiklar
dd983a6e-a9da-4d50-bf3f-11e40f8ee87e.description: Faqat shifokor tavsiyasi bilan. Ayrimlari (masalan: Amoksitsillin) xavfsiz, boshqalari esa xavfsiz emas.

d2b2547b-a246-46d2-8237-ba956bc10193.name: Sarimsoq
d2b2547b-a246-46d2-8237-ba956bc10193.description: Immunitet uchun foydali, ammo jig‘ildon qaynashiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.

d35818e9-239f-4c36-89db-cbe81b4ecb74.name: Mikroto‘lqinli pech
d35818e9-239f-4c36-89db-cbe81b4ecb74.description: Radiatsiya sizib chiqarmaydi, unda ovqat isitish xavfsiz.

d5486e80-7fee-4805-914d-8ff740f6faf3.name: Gaviscon / Rennie
d5486e80-7fee-4805-914d-8ff740f6faf3.description: Jig‘ildon qaynashida homiladorlar uchun xavfsiz hisoblanadi.

d73743e4-7872-43bc-9d17-1a2b6c256ae0.name: Syorfing
d73743e4-7872-43bc-9d17-1a2b6c256ae0.description: Syorfingda yiqilish, to‘qnashish, taxta yoki suv zarbasiga uchrash xavfi yuqori bo‘lib, bu homilador ayollar uchun xavfli bo‘lishi mumkin. Umuman olganda, homiladorlik davrida, ayniqsa homiladorlik muddati oshib, muvozanat o‘zgargani sari syorfing tavsiya etilmaydi.

e3acc785-40e5-4a92-9bb2-facf384272da.name: Ismaloq
e3acc785-40e5-4a92-9bb2-facf384272da.description: Temir manbai, pishirilgan holda yaxshiroq o‘zlashtiriladi.

e3d7d111-d05a-4b2d-8259-4020258da02d.name: Olma / Nok
e3d7d111-d05a-4b2d-8259-4020258da02d.description: Kletchatka manbai, uni po‘sti bilan (yaxshilab yuvib) iste’mol qilish tavsiya etiladi.

e45b4364-5c8b-4e45-80ff-f195d16c602d.name: Qahva
e45b4364-5c8b-4e45-80ff-f195d16c602d.description: Kunlik kofein miqdori 200 mq (1-2 fincan) bilan cheklanishi kerak.

e82735f7-b021-4a7e-b97d-c632edb2796e.name: Kivi
e82735f7-b021-4a7e-b97d-c632edb2796e.description: C vitaminiga boy, ovqat hazm qilishga yordam beradi.

dfbf3657-efd8-4d40-aebd-02c15dc7e574.name: Dazmol qilish
dfbf3657-efd8-4d40-aebd-02c15dc7e574.description: Uzoq vaqt oyoqda turmang, tanaffus qilib turing.

e36740b3-4dab-40b2-b734-4b1f66249624.name: Sushi (xom baliq)
e36740b3-4dab-40b2-b734-4b1f66249624.description: Listeriya va parazitlar yuqishi xavfi mavjud. Faqat to'liq pishirilgan rollarni (masalan: sabzavotli, pishirilgan lososli) iste'mol qilish mumkin.

e38db223-f68f-44d7-bb0a-b2d6dc99f899.name: Atir (parfyum)
e38db223-f68f-44d7-bb0a-b2d6dc99f899.description: Xavfsiz. Agar hidi ko'ngil aynishiga sabab bo'lsa, ishlatmang.

e390a057-a91c-44d7-8571-ad77d64de8fa.name: Sikloferon
e390a057-a91c-44d7-8571-ad77d64de8fa.description: Immunitetni rag'batlantiruvchi vosita bo'lib, homiladorlikda qo'llash tavsiya etilmaydi.

ea5fcb8d-f293-4de1-b03f-867f11696e2f.name: Limon / Mandarin
ea5fcb8d-f293-4de1-b03f-867f11696e2f.description: C vitamini manbai. Oshqozon kislotaliligiga e’tibor bering.

eacea764-9a60-4512-9fc1-2c70987d75c9.name: Yoga
eacea764-9a60-4512-9fc1-2c70987d75c9.description: Homiladorlar uchun maxsus yoga foydali. Teskari holatlardan saqlaning.

ebd56f45-7d64-4b54-b3b5-9531167ca52c.name: Papayya
ebd56f45-7d64-4b54-b3b5-9531167ca52c.description: To‘liq pishgan holda xavfsiz. Xom (yashil) papayya bachadon qisqarishiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.

ed98f8fa-3592-4ed0-a9f8-3d16571b2d82.name: Metall detektori (aeroport)
ed98f8fa-3592-4ed0-a9f8-3d16571b2d82.description: Magnit maydoni kuchsiz, homilaga zarar yetkazmaydi.

ee7f4fa6-99e7-4619-8a6a-1e1d0b1b9a0e.name: Gilam qoqish
ee7f4fa6-99e7-4619-8a6a-1e1d0b1b9a0e.description: Bu og‘ir jismoniy ish bo‘lib, chang allergiyaga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.

ef0ef853-8c34-4ff4-9adb-779e825cc1db.name: Za’faron
ef0ef853-8c34-4ff4-9adb-779e825cc1db.description: Palovda oz miqdorda (bir chimdim) zararsiz. Yuqori dozada (davolash maqsadida) taqiqlanadi.

f0142910-ca1a-444d-82b7-dd12c3cdce1a.name: Qattiq pishloqlar
f0142910-ca1a-444d-82b7-dd12c3cdce1a.description: Cheddar, Gollandiya pishlog‘i va Parmezan kabi pishloqlar odatda xavfsizdir.

f06cb3ee-7349-4f72-a537-222dd53ee3c8.name: Soch kestirish
f06cb3ee-7349-4f72-a537-222dd53ee3c8.description: Mutlaqo xavfsiz. Xalq orasidagi ishonchlar (afsonalar) hech qanday asosga ega emas.

f08663bc-1154-49bb-a9f7-231ae2fb7bde.name: Magniy
f08663bc-1154-49bb-a9f7-231ae2fb7bde.description: Mushak tirishishi (kramp) va tonus uchun xavfsizdir.

f2533a58-22fe-41b5-b1ab-cecccbef8362.name: Banan
f2533a58-22fe-41b5-b1ab-cecccbef8362.description: Kaliy manbai bo‘lib, mushak tirishishini (krampni) kamaytiradi.

f6a6dd27-8d74-412d-b6fb-b1110e2c447c.name: Ot minish / Chang‘i uchish
f6a6dd27-8d74-412d-b6fb-b1110e2c447c.description: Yiqilish va jarohatlanish xavfi yuqori bo‘lgan sport turlari taqiqlanadi.

fbbad452-a7d0-41f7-a1d8-63efe62647b4.name: Kekik (Timyan)
fbbad452-a7d0-41f7-a1d8-63efe62647b4.description: Choyga xushbo‘y hid berish uchun oz miqdorda qo‘shish mumkin. Quyuq damlab ko‘p ichish bachadon tonusini oshirishi mumkin.

fc128896-012c-4f81-ac31-549e0a5cc789.name: Velosiped
fc128896-012c-4f81-ac31-549e0a5cc789.description: Muvozanatni yo‘qotish xavfi bor. Velotrenajyor (statsionar velosiped) xavfsizroq.

fd716581-39ca-4226-8009-c559ab79d883.name: Chalqancha uxlash
fd716581-39ca-4226-8009-c559ab79d883.description: 20-haftadan keyin tavsiya etilmaydi (qon tomirini siqadi). Chap yonboshingizda uxlang.

ff2f4a10-f7ce-4435-80d7-15496b65de47.name: Faollashtirilgan ko‘mir
ff2f4a10-f7ce-4435-80d7-15496b65de47.description: Zaharlanish va qorin dam bo‘lganda sorbent sifatida xavfsiz (qonga so‘rilmaydi).
